title: SG-1.2.2 · Create the typed UI store in game/frontend/src/store
summary: Create useUiStore in game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts with drawer, modal, sound and settings state, actions and a typed hook.
description: Context: game/frontend has zustand ^5.1.0 declared (SG-1.2.1) but no src/store directory exists. Desired behavior: a Zustand UI store holds drawer open state, modal state, sound enabled and settings flags, with actions toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings, exported as a typed hook. Expected result: components can import useUiStore. Why: the shell, header and contribution modal share UI state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the module src/store/uiStore.ts, when imported, then it exports a typed useUiStore hook and a UiState type
Given the store, when each action is called, then drawer, modal, sound and settings state change as specified

out_of_scope: Wiring the store into GameLayout, HeaderOverlay or App

technical_constraints: Use zustand ^5.1.0 create() with TypeScript types
Tests live in game/frontend/tests and match tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}
